user_goal.en: a shared outcome map with ownership, leading indicators, and conflict-resolution rules

task.expected_artifact: a shared outcome map with ownership, leading indicators, and conflict-resolution rules

messages.content:
다음 이해관계자를 고려한 계획을 설계해줘: 팀 간 OKR 정렬 계획
맥락: 제품팀은 사용률, 운영팀은 안정성, 재무팀은 비용을 측정하며 같은 이니셔티브가 세 계획에 모두 들어 있다.
산출물: 공동 성과 지도와 담당, 선행 지표, 충돌 해결 규칙
서로 다른 지표를 하나의 점수로 합치거나 합의 없이 담당을 정하지 않는다.
빠르게 부탁: 팀 간 OKR 정렬 계획 — 메모는 제품팀은 사용률, 운영팀은 안정성, 재무팀은 비용을 측정하며 같은 이니셔티브가 세 안에 모두 들어 있어., 결과는 공동 성과 지도와 담당, 선행 지표, 충돌 해결 규칙. 없는 정보는 추정하지 말고 표시해줘
추가로, 결정에 중요한 정보가 빠졌으면 만들지 말고 질문하거나 가정을 표시해줘.

Design a plan for a cross-team OKR alignment plan. Context: Product measures adoption, operations measures reliability, and finance measures cost; the same initiative appears in all three plans. Deliver: a shared outcome map with ownership, leading indicators, and conflict-resolution rules. Do not collapse distinct metrics into one score or assign ownership without agreement.

quick one: a cross-team OKR alignment plan — I’ve got Product measures adoption, operations measures reliability, and also finance measures cost; the same initiative appears in all three plans.; can you give me a shared outcome map with ownership, leading indicators, and also conflict-resolution rules? no invented details pls
One more thing: if a decision-critical detail is missing, ask or state the assumption instead of inventing it.

invariants: Preserve the stated facts and constraints for a cross-team OKR alignment plan.
Do not collapse distinct metrics into one score or assign ownership without agreement.
Distinguish confirmed information, assumptions, and missing evidence.
Do not claim an external action, source check, or professional determination that did not occur.
failure_signals: The response changes or omits a decision-critical fact about a cross-team OKR alignment plan.
Do not collapse distinct metrics into one score or assign ownership without agreement.
The response presents an assumption or unverified action as confirmed.
